en.auth.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this phone.
en.auth.linkOtherDevice: You opened the link on a different phone. Type your email again to finish signing in.
en.auth.inviteNotSent: The invite is saved, but the email was not sent. Share the join link instead.
en.auth.error.invalidEmail: This email address does not look right.
en.auth.error.missingEmail: Type the email address you asked the link for.
en.auth.error.linkInvalid: This sign-in link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
en.auth.error.linkExpired: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
en.auth.error.popupClosed: The Google window was closed before signing in.
en.auth.error.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
en.auth.error.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
en.auth.error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
en.auth.error.quota: Today's limit of sign-in emails is reached. Use Google sign-in or try tomorrow.
en.auth.error.domain: This web address is not allowed to sign in yet. The owner must add it in Firebase.
en.auth.error.provider: This sign-in method is not turned on for the app yet.
en.auth.error.otherProvider: This email already signs in another way. Use the email link.
en.auth.error.noInvite: There is no invite for this email at this shop. Ask the owner to invite you.
en.auth.error.notVerified: Sign in with the email link or with Google so your email is verified.
en.auth.error.permission: You do not have access to this.
en.auth.error.generic: Sign-in did not work. Try again.

ar.auth.linkSent: أرسلنا رابط الدخول إلى {email}. افتحه على هذا الجهاز.
